::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
## The data portal is not live yet
Pangenome graphs and the SV-eQTL database will be released upon publication. [Follow the news](news/index.qmd) for release announcements.
:::

## Open resources

**LatinPangenome graph and SV catalog.** Graph files and variant calls, downloadable from this site with documentation and versioning.

**eQTL database.** Browsable and downloadable associations for structural variants and SNPs across 29 cell types.

**Single-cell expression.** Gene count matrices through [CZ CELLxGENE](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/), maintained by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

## Controlled access

Individual-level whole-genome sequences will be deposited in the [European Genome-phenome Archive](https://ega-archive.org/). Researchers apply through EGA, and requests are reviewed by a Data Access Committee of Latin Pangenomes researchers. The committee's role is to make sure uses are consistent with the consent participants gave and with the expectations of their communities.
